daily.today_energy: The universe is giving you that slow-burn confidence today. You're radiating a quiet magnetic energy that draws the right people and opportunities closer—trust the vibe shift happening beneath the surface.
daily.love: If you're coupled up, there's tenderness in the air and a chance to have a real conversation that matters. Single? Someone's been noticing your energy. Keep it authentic and see what unfolds naturally.
daily.career: Your work is gaining momentum even if it doesn't feel obvious yet. This is a day to show up consistently and plant seeds for future wins. Your dedication is being registered by the universe.
daily.health: Your body's asking for grounding right now—think walks, stretching, or anything that connects you to the earth. Moving slowly and intentionally will feel way better than pushing hard.

weekly.overview: Your vibe is shifting toward authenticity this week, Taurus. Mercury's energy is pushing you to speak your truth without the usual filter. Trust the momentum—clarity feels good on you right now.
weekly.love: Someone's noticing the real you, and honestly? That's the whole point. Whether you're coupled or single, this is about magnetic honesty. Show up as you are, not as a polished version.
